result.brief: 提出 EditaLive 实时流式人物视频编辑框架，将图像动画模型改造为因果流式生成，并用自 rollout 蒸馏压缩为两步采样器，兼顾表情保真与低延迟。
result.reason: Real-time streaming character video editing built on image animation model with causal streaming generation and self-rollout distillation; directly serves video generation and controllable editing.
